tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the shell and every card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, header, table, drawer, dialog, popover.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Table header and footer rows, quiet buttons, inputs, the neutral pill, the calculation box.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards, chips and inputs; row separators. Decorative: it does not carry meaning on its own.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed outline of an empty area and other emphasised dividers.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy, table cells and titles on bg, surface, surface-alt and row-anomaly.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and uppercase labels on surface and surface-alt. On bg in the light theme it reaches 4.43:1, just under 4.5: keep muted text on bg at 19px bold or larger, or move it onto a surface.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and the eyebrow above a drawer title. 2.5:1 on surface in the light theme (3.8:1 dark): never the only carrier of information.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active navigation text, links, the computed amount, focus ring. As text on surface and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Active navigation ground, highlighted stat card, icon tile, the computed-amount strip.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (button label, active badge).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons on success-soft; the 'A peso' mode pill.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a positive pill or timeline dot.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Anomaly text and icons on warn-soft; the anomaly badge fill. On warn-soft in the light theme it reaches 4.42:1, just under 4.5: set it at semibold.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an anomaly notice, pill or active anomaly view.

tokens.name: warn-border
tokens.usage: Border of an active anomaly chip.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill (the anomaly count badge). Added here: the mockup used literal white, which fails on the dark theme's amber.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive actions on danger-soft and surface. Always paired with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error pill or notice.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational pill text on info-soft; the 'Oraria' mode pill.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an informational pill.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: The 'Forfettario' mode pill text on purple-soft. A category colour, never a status.

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the 'Forfettario' pill.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Table row under the pointer.

tokens.name: row-anomaly
tokens.usage: Table row of a trip with an open anomaly.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Veil behind a drawer or a dialog.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The one title of a page.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Title of a section inside a page.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Title of a dialog or a drawer.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Per questo cliente non è definita una tariffa.
styles.usage: Default text: table cells, navigation, buttons, notices.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Pill text. In capitals with tracking: table header, group label of the navigation, eyebrow.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a value, stat label, count badge. Always uppercase.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The number of a stat card.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: The computed amount of a trip.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Trip numbers, plates, quantities and amounts in tables. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its count; label to value.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and small buttons; vertical padding of a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a table cell, a button and a navigation item.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a table cell, a chip and an input; gap in a navigation item.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between the blocks of a drawer.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of a drawer and a dialog; header side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a small control: button, input, select, search field.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of the default control; the avatar.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of a large control, for touch.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Icon inside a pill or a count.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icon inside a small control; the small spinner.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon; the checkbox.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icon in a large control; the spinner.

tokens.name: tile-md
tokens.usage: Icon tile of a stat card.

tokens.name: tile-lg
tokens.usage: Icon tile of a dialog.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills and count badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, filter chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, navigation items, icon tiles, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Saved-view chips, timeline dots, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: The one shadow of the system: a popover menu over the page. Cards are set apart by border, never by shadow.
